architecture_layers.value: Content tables (src/lib/content.ts — every table and tuning number) -> pure engine (src/lib/engine.ts — formulas and derived state, no IO/DOM) -> action layer (src/lib/actions.ts — the extracted pure mutation seam) -> store + persistence (src/lib/store.ts zustand, src/lib/save.ts) -> React UI (src/App.tsx, src/components/) -> PWA shell (index.html, public/). The simulator (src/lib/sim/, pnpm sim) consumes the same engine + action layer — never a second implementation. Imports point left-to-right only; docs/DESIGN.md is the binding mechanics map.

drift_resolution.value: The live tree wins over every doc; docs/DESIGN.md wins on intended mechanics. On disagreement: measure the tree first, then either fix the code to the decided design or correct the decision record in DESIGN.md — never silently, and never a tuning change without simulator evidence. Known instance of the pattern: the Lore-permanence defect is recorded in DESIGN.md section 9.2 with its fix path rather than patched ad hoc.

fleet_dark_repos.value: None that this repo's work touches. The estate's parked and frozen repos are indexed with one line each in fleet-manager docs/ESTATE.md; the standing hard rail estate-wide: superbot's live Discord worker and its two Postgres databases are never touched uninvited.

fleet_siblings.value: fleet-manager (the estate hub and records home — its docs/repos/couch-legend/ folder is the cross-session entry point; owner sessions boot there); substrate-kit (this kit's home); product-forge/phone-controller (the signed-APK release rails the Android/Capacitor shell will reuse, DESIGN.md section 7); spider-swing (the estate's other live game — shares the image-prompt/asset-pipeline art method via fleet-manager skills).

fleet_status_command.value: None — the seat-era roster machinery is retired (2026-08-07). Estate state is read, not generated: fleet-manager docs/ESTATE.md (the index) + docs/current-state.md; kit adopter currency is regenerated only inside substrate-kit (python3 dist/bootstrap.py currency, read-only over the fleet).

mutation_seam.value: All game-state mutations go through the pure action layer (src/lib/actions.ts), consumed identically by the zustand store and the simulator; UI components dispatch actions and never write game state directly. Tuning numbers live in src/lib/content.ts and change only with simulator evidence inside DESIGN.md section 9.6 fairness rails.

new_area_ownership.value: A new area (mechanic, currency, tab, platform shell) is decided in docs/DESIGN.md BEFORE code lands — the repo's founding rule: mechanics mapped and decided first. Anything touching balance or pacing needs simulator evidence (pnpm sim) against the section 9.6 rails before adoption.

owner_profile.value: Non-coder product owner; supplies judgment, direction and taste — he plays the game and states direction live (the 2026-08-21 looks pass approved the Lucid Chronicle treatment this way). Explain mechanisms in plain language, give recommendations with a default rather than option menus, ask immediately on genuine forks and keep working. Canonical profile: fleet-manager docs/owner-profile.md + docs/intent.md section 7.

ownership_model.value: Single owner (menno420) owns product, design and every ruling. docs/DESIGN.md is the binding mechanics map — every resource, loop, formula and table is decided there (section 9 = the life-story stage system; section 9.6 = the numeric fairness rails). Sessions decide implementation detail, decide-and-flag reversible design choices, and put genuine product forks to the owner.

primary_language.value: TypeScript 5.9 — Vite 7 + React 19 web app, Node >=20 with pnpm; the game engine and simulator are pure TypeScript. Python 3 only for the vendored substrate-kit bootstrap.

review_ritual.value: Codex reviews every PR — trigger on open, draft-to-ready, or the literal comment '@codex review'; it answers in about 5.5 minutes with findings as INLINE comments (read /pulls/N/comments, a bare summary is not the review). Never merge a PR you asked it to review before it answers; a review binds the exact head SHA. Tuning changes carry simulator evidence; the owner playtests feel. Required checks on main: ci (pnpm check) and substrate-gate.

staleness_review.value: docs/current-state.md is re-trued at each session close; DESIGN.md sections carry their decision dates. Cross-session thread state lives in fleet-manager docs/repos/couch-legend/ and is refreshed by that repo's session-close Layer-2 step. Config staleness bar: 14 days (substrate.config.json cadence).

verify_command.value: pnpm check (tsc --noEmit + vitest run + vite build — the one product gate, CI job 'ci'); kit discipline: python3 bootstrap.py check --strict; balance evidence: pnpm sim
